x-ctx-provenance.extract: components.schemas: CreateEmbeddingResponse and its transitive $ref closure (Embedding), values equal to the source, re-serialized with key order preserved

data.description: The list of embeddings generated by the model.

model.description: The name of the model used to generate the embedding.

object.description: The object type, which is always "list".

usage.description: The usage information for the request.

prompt_tokens.description: The number of tokens used by the prompt.

total_tokens.description: The total number of tokens used by the request.

Embedding.description: Represents an embedding vector returned by embedding endpoint.

index.description: The index of the embedding in the list of embeddings.

embedding.description: The embedding vector, returned as a list of floats when `encoding_format` is `float` (the default), or as a base64-encoded string when `encoding_format` is `base64`. The length of the vector depends on the model as listed in the [embedding guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/embeddings).

object.description: The object type, which is always "embedding".
